notes.title: Game start up time enhanced!
notes.content:
Due to the continued growth of the music list, we noticed that the game start up time have increased. We have worked on improving the game start up speeds by looking into the connection process and how data is handled. By using the latest version  (ver1.2.1.0007), we have updated the game to start up faster.  

We hope that you will continue to enjoy GrooveCoaster. 

[h1]Additional Info[/h1]
The latest version has been tested and updated. We have also prepared a way to use the old build, in case you have trouble with the new system build, 

Right click and open the menu by selecting the GrooveCoaster icon in the [Library]   
Select, “Property”, “Beta”,”Old Version”, to play the game with the previous build.
*The game client will be started with the Ver1.2.1.0006 build.
*This version will be removed after we have confirmed the newest build is stable.

notes.title: About the “sync issue” for in game targets.
notes.content:
First off we would like to offer our most sincere thanks to all of those who have bought and played Groove Coaster.

From the initial reports of sync issues with notes, we have tried to help resolve the problem through finer calibration settings in-game.

However even with the additional calibration options, it became apparent that many other of our users were still experiencing issues with synchronization or having to re-calibrate for each song. Due to the various combinations of PC set ups and other details from user reports, after investigating the issue further we (Degica & Taito) have decided that it would be difficult to resolve the reported desynching issue in a satisfactory manner for all affected users.

In the event that you experience desynchronization, please make sure
- no other programs are running
- your system meets the minimum system specs below.

[u][b]Minimum System Requirements[/b][/u]
OS: Windows7/8.1/10 (64bit)
Processor: 2.0 GHz+
Memory: 2 GB RAM
DirectX: Version 11
Storage: 400 MB

notes.content:
Hi there Groove Coaster fans!

We would like to help present a work around to the issue involving some button inputs not responding while playing.

The main cause of this issue has been narrowed down to the analog stick not being recognized as having returned to the neutral position after use.

[h1]Please follow the steps below for the temporary workaround to this issue.[/h1]
[list][*]On the Steam browser, select “Steam” in the upper left corner.
[*]Select the following, ”Settings” -> “Controller” -> “General Controller Settings”
[*]”Selected Controller” -> “Calibrate”
[*]From here please adjust the dead zone slide bars for the L / R analog sticks. Moving the slide bar to the right will increase the size of the neutral zone.[/list]

*Dead zone slide bar settings will differ by controller.

notes.title: Groove Coaster - Controller Troubleshooting Info
notes.content:
To all our Groove Coaster fans,

We have gotten multiple reports of issues of controllers not working with the game.

Below is some general information that we hope will help resolve the issues you are experiencing.

[b][u]Please perform the following steps in Big Picture Mode before running Groove Coaster.[/u]

[h1]Enabling Controller Support[/h1]
[list][*]In Steam client click STEAM from the top menu.
[*]Select Settings - Controller - General Controller Settings.
[*]In General Controller Settings make sure your controller of choice PS4 / Xbox / Generic is checked on.
[*]Steam Controller users, ensure the Wireless Receiver USB device is plugged in and controller is turned on before starting Groove Coaster.
[*]After completing the steps above, please exit and restart Steam at least once in order for the changes to properly take effect.
[*]Refer to “manual_en.pdf” file (link below) for further controls details.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/744060/manuals/manual_en.pdf?t=1531785652[/list]

[h1]Checking / Changing Controller Config[/h1]
[list][*]With controller plugged in / Groove Coaster running open the Steam overlay with Shift + Tab
[*]In overlay select Controller Configuration
[*]Screen should change to “Groove Coaster for Steam Official Setting”, screen with active controller displayed.
[*]From this screen you can make changes to your button configuration for Groove Coaster.[/list]
